title: Effects of Osteopathic Techniques on Residual Volume in Severe Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether the selected osteopathic techniques have a positive impact on the residual volume decrease in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease with severe and very severe airflow limitation in comparison to the manual therapy not aimed to decrease hyperinflation (placebo).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* a clinical diagnosis of COPD in accordance with GOLD,
* post-bronchodilator FEV1 \< 50% of predicted value,
* smoking history of ≥ 10 pack-years,
* the ability to remain in supine position for at least 25 minutes.

Exclusion Criteria:

* exacerbation in the past 6 weeks,
